title: default_username_claim uses .to_string() on literal — inconsistent with commit's own fixes
description: The commit 4fa767e explicitly changed all default_* serde functions to use .to_owned() on string literals, citing clippy correctness. auth/src/config.rs:73 default_username_claim() still uses "email".to_string(). A future contributor will see mixed style and not know which is the house style. The commit message claims all default-value functions were fixed, which is incorrect.
